issues.title: Erratic intra-word kerning and spacing
issues.description: Certain text strings render with unintended spaces splitting words.
issues.evidence: Visible gaps in 'Fully auto no mo us', 'finis hes', and 's ummary'.
issues.suggestion: Fix font-rendering/tracking CSS or string token concatenation.
issues.triageNote: JPEG/vision misread: char-level DOM Range rects on pair-089 (dark, 1024x768, dsf 1.5) show max intra-word gap = 0px for every cited string ('Fully autonomous', 'finishes', 'summary', plus re-audit's 'Monday', 'can retune'); letter-spacing normal, word-spacing 0, no justify, no mid-string line breaks; real space chars measure 3-4px so a phantom space would be visible. The 3 originally cited strings are not even inside .typeset (computed text-wrap: wrap, not pretty), and typeset text with text-wrap: pretty also measures 0px intra-word gaps. Re-audit re-reported 'word splitting' on a DIFFERENT set of words against an identical DOM — nondeterministic misread of JPEG q88 artifacts on ~16px-tall glyphs. No code change made.
